headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token. Without one, nine of the twelve tools run 25 times a day per network (the answers say how many calls are left). A free key from https://vulntel.com/signup lifts that to 60 calls a minute and adds observe, assist_submission and search_public_code: send Bearer <your-key>.
